Genuine Truck Parts & Accessories

Genuine OEM and quality aftermarket commercial truck parts from Carolina International Trucks in South Carolina and Rechtien International Trucks in South Florida. Order online, request a part, or visit a parts counter near you.
Commercial truck parts experts

Every commercial truck needs new components at some point in its lifespan, and the quality of the parts you install shapes how productive those years are. Carolina International Trucks and Rechtien International Trucks stock heavy duty truck parts and accessories manufactured with high-grade materials, so the longevity and integrity of your fleet are in good hands.

Whether you are looking for International® truck parts, Hino parts, Freightliner® truck parts or something more generic, our trained parts specialists help you find the right semi truck part at the right price — from battery replacements to engine repairs.

Our professionally trained and experienced staff help you identify the right commercial truck part the first time around. They keep their expertise current through training modules, classes and seminars.

props.eyebrow: Choose the right part for the job

props.text: Genuine OEM truck parts

We carry genuine OEM parts for the International® and Hino trucks we sell and service. Genuine OEM parts are made to the manufacturer's specification for your truck, which supports compatibility and reliable performance, and our parts specialists can help you confirm the right part number for your application.
Carolina International Trucks is International Diamond Edge Certified.
Quality aftermarket parts

When a less expensive option makes sense, we offer a selection of high-quality aftermarket parts from the supplier brands listed above, including Fleetrite, Fleetguard, Dorman HD Solutions and more. Ask the parts team which option fits your truck, your budget and your downtime.

Warranty: Carolina International Trucks states that almost every product it sells comes with an unlimited-mile, one-year warranty. Warranty coverage varies by product and location, so ask the parts team about the specific part you need.

It is essential to start and end your driving days with inspections of your truck's vital parts and systems. Pre-trip and post-trip Driver Vehicle Inspection Reports (DVIRs) help you track which parts need to be replaced, avoiding problems down the road. An extensive parts inventory
Carolina International Trucks

Our facility carries over 200 different product lines to help outfit your truck and trailer with high-quality components so you can upgrade and customize performance. Carolina International Trucks describes this as the largest selection of commercial truck parts in South Carolina, with shelves stocked with premium heavy truck parts.
Carolina International Trucks also runs quarterly parts promotions — ask your local parts counter what is available now.
Rechtien International Trucks

Rechtien's trained parts specialists help you find the right semi truck part at the right price, with a wide selection across the brands we represent and multiple South Florida locations to serve you.
Rechtien is also part of the International 360 program, which makes it easy to track the status of your commercial truck's maintenance and repair needs.
Parts delivery services
Each dealership delivers within its own region. The two service areas below are separate — contact the parts department closest to you to ask about delivery.
South Carolina — Carolina International Trucks

Besides keeping our shelves stocked with premium heavy truck parts, we can have them delivered right to your doorstep. Our delivery fleet of over 20 vehicles can cover more than 80% of the state, and most areas are serviced twice a day.
Carolina International Trucks describes its truck parts delivery service as free. Call (800) 868-4923 and ask one of our friendly staff about delivery to your location.
South Florida — Rechtien International Trucks
Submit a parts order form online and we'll get to work on fulfilling your order. We also deliver parts to your direct location in the following counties:

props.text: Truck parts questions

items.q: Do you sell OEM and aftermarket truck parts?
items.a: Yes. We carry genuine OEM parts as well as a selection of less expensive, high-quality aftermarket options.

Carolina International Trucks delivers across South Carolina with a fleet of over 20 vehicles covering more than 80% of the state, and describes the service as free. Rechtien International Trucks delivers to Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Indian River, St. Lucie, Martin and Okeechobee counties in South Florida.

items.q: How do I request a part?
items.a: Fill out the parts request form on this page, or call the parts line at Carolina International Trucks on (800) 868-4923, or contact your nearest Rechtien International location. A parts specialist will contact you.

items.q: Which truck brands do you supply parts for?
items.a: Our parts specialists can help you find parts for International® and Hino trucks, as well as Freightliner® and more generic applications, from the supplier brands we represent.

items.q: Is there a warranty on parts?
items.a: Carolina International Trucks states that almost every product it sells comes with an unlimited-mile, one-year warranty. Warranty coverage varies by product and location, so ask the parts team about your specific part.
